Re: Account reference ACC-900185

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the debt as identity theft, citing that the debt was settled in full with another creditor, XXXX, and that World Finance Corporation is reporting a charge-off and collection balance of $900.00.

We have reviewed the account information on file, and the current balance is $1,686.13. The original creditor for this account is Metro Physicians Group. The charge-off date for this account was March 30, 2021. We have no record of a payment being made on this account.

As per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute. We will review the account information and verify the accuracy of the debt. We will also contact World Finance Corporation to confirm their reporting of the debt.

Please be advised that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is not accurate. You may also request validation of the debt, which we will provide if necessary.

We will investigate this matter and respond to you with the results of our investigation. If our investigation confirms that the debt is not accurate, we will take the necessary steps to correct our records and cease collection activities.

Sincerely,

Continental Receivables Corp.
